title: Question on the page "hits"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[hits](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hits.html)".

I think example on bottom of the page doesn't work, at least when trying to transform items inside transformItems method -- nothing happens. While debugging, it doesn't even goes inside there.

comments.body:
What version of InstantSearch are you using? (this documentation is for the v2). Also it would be helpful if you could recreate your issue in [codesandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js-2.x), so we can help out more effectively.

From my tests `transformItems` seems to be working correctly. One issue with the example is that it's using `{{{_highlightResult.name.value}}}` and this highlight helper only works on the original `hit` value (even if it was transformed). I agree that it can be confusing and we should fix this example.

`transformItems` was added in `2.10.0` ([Changelog](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#2100-2018-08-08)), so you'll need to upgrade to use it.

This is only a minor version (we're following [semver](https://semver.org/)) so you should be able to upgrade without any problem.
